CREATE TABLE krrg_employee_educations ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, university_id BIGINT, education_type_id BIGINT, specialty_id BIGINT, start_year INTEGER, end_year INTEGER
CONSTRAINT fk_employee_education_university FOREIGN KEY (university_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_university(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_employee_education_type FOREIGN KEY (education_type_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_education_type(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_employee_education_specialty FOREIGN KEY (specialty_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_specialty(id) );
